lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular clusters arranged in a patterned grid posterior to the gill region; spots exhibit varying diameters with a higher concentration of smaller spots proximal to the pectoral fin base.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting horizontal rows of blobs, creating a grid-like alignment on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Parallel horizontal linear features on the upper flank characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from dorsal highlights to ventral shadows.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin displays a dense distribution of high-luminance punctate spots, particularly concentrated along the leading edge.
